approved: Revision of the adopted candidate 1 (same reconstruction and textures), centred on the feet; adopted after the delivered-character tests in this session (2026-10-13).
request: User (2026-10-13): AとCみたいなのも作って。 女の子と男の子、何種類かつくりたい。codex のサブスク枠でgpt-image使って候補いくつか見せて。 -> after the ten designs of chibi-cast/review/cast1-sheet.png: 全員採用。 (all ten adopted; one 3D candidate per instruction: G1 first)

reference.generator: Codex built-in image_gen (codex-cli 0.162.0-alpha.17.2, gpt-5.6-sol, reasoning medium; ChatGPT plan, no API key); the adopted chibi woman (candidate5-ref-b.png) and the user style image attached to every call

castSheet.note: the ten designs shown to the user

chosen.design: G1: fluffy chin-length bob with a short braid in front of each ear (leather cord, bone bead), a speckled feather behind one ear, amber eyes, three red-ochre dots on each cheek, honey-tan hide dress with cream fur trim and a red-ochre zigzag hem, reddish-brown fur shoulder cape with a bone toggle, shell necklace, belt with a pouch, fur-cuffed laced boots

referenceMatte.method: BiRefNet cutout of the TRELLIS preparation moved onto the original reference (offset 267,6 px, NCC 0.981; the faces differ)

trellis.settings: local TRELLIS-2 C++ GGUF, res 1024, tex 1024, BiRefNet matte, xatlas atlas 2048

blankFace.reason: as for the chibi woman (docs/cro-magnon-woman-chibi-2026-10-13.md): TRELLIS-2 carves painted anime eyes into recesses; a copy of the reference with the eyes, lash tips, cheek dots, nose and mouth filled by the fitted skin colour reconstructs a smooth face, the painted face is projected afterwards
blankFace.script: scripts/remake/blank_face.py (eye ellipses 405,428,52,50 and 612,428,52,50, lash tips, cheek dots, nose, mouth; limit 1.3, blur 3; every hair box its own colour)
rejected: r01: eye ellipses 62 px wide and brow ellipses took the side locks and bang tips into the fill
blankFace.note: the fill boundary still reconstructed as shallow oval steps around the eyes (dense mesh); they vanish in the reduction, and the face normals are flattened (project_face.py --flat-normals 1.0)

reduction.split: faces with centroid y >= 0.134 (dense units; 0.919 m placed, between the chin and the collar) form the head
reduction.budgetsLookedAt: 7000 boost 1.6 (head 4573 / body 2353: arms and boots too coarse), 8000 boost 1.2 (chosen), 9000 boost 1.0 (qa/budgets.png); the bob, braids and feather need more head triangles than the woman's buns

body.settings: CIELAB quantile matching to the reference subject in rows 580-1475

head.settings: hair class: CIELAB mean and spread moved onto the reference hair in rows 60-580

colour.measured: aligned raw albedo (chibi_views --align, both sides drawn) against the reference: hair 13 % lighter, tunic 13 % darker, boots darker; skin of the hands and legs more orange than the projected face (fixed with the skin material tone)

face.settings: replace mode, ellipse 1.339/1.386/-0.171/0.2 from the eye and chin rows 428/567, facing 0.05-0.3, hair guard except in the eye ellipses 405,428,70,64 and 612,428,70,64 and dark regions thinner than 9 texels, skin tone matched halfway (--tone-match --tone-strength 0.5), face normals flattened (--flat-normals 1.0), no optical flow, registration as above, output 1024, WebP q92

skinMaterial.reason: the clothing dye recolours by colour classes: the bare skin (hands, legs, front of the neck) is a second material with the same textures; its skin texels moved onto the projected face colour (253,190,154)

motion.chain: scripts/remake/human_chain.sh (rig_human_c2 -> spear thrust r1 -> Downed -> CMU locomotion r1) with LOCOMOTION_CADENCE=Walk_Loop:1.7,Run_Loop:1.5 and TEMPLATE_ASSET=rig/template-asset.json (a new key has no delivered manifest)

Walk_Loop.method: CMU measured human locomotion, anatomical retarget and sole contact

Run_Loop.method: CMU measured human locomotion, anatomical retarget and sole contact

qa.game: output/playwright/g1-candidate-game-r01 (isolated in-memory server, real title/selection/entry, the candidate routed into the chibi woman's slot; Idle/Walk/Run/Attack seen; 0 page errors)
